name: video-skills
description: Finds the right agent skill for an AI video, image, voice or music job on varg how to (varg.ai/how-to, 2,000+ checked skills and tutorials: UGC ads, product videos, music videos, captions, talking avatars, podcasts, faceless channels, explainers, launch videos, chat-story ads, dubbing, shorts from long videos) and shows the visual options before anything is generated. Use when someone asks to make, edit, caption, voice, dub or animate a video, asks "which skill should I use", "find a skill for", "how do I make a ... video", or wants images, voiceover or music for a video, and no installed skill already covers that format; use it before writing a pipeline from scratch or searching registries. Not for running a generation itself (use varg-ai), not for formats with their own varg skill (varg-music-video, varg-character-keynote, varg-consistent-characters, varg-character-design, varg-podcast-video, varg-product-hook, varg-dropship-reel, varg-previz), and not for non-media coding tasks.
